reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies a single PGM-free intervention, realistic poison/thermal-cycling conditions, quantitative comparisons, and a decisive coated-versus-uncoated aging experiment, while cited HEO studies support water tolerance, oxidation activity, and sintering resistance. Its ultrathin conformal-coating concept and numerical targets remain extrapolations—and site blocking is a risk—but A is substantially less bounded, less evidentially grounded, and less decisively testable.
